population: Adults with stable nondialysis CKD G3–G5; never previously treated with maintenance dialysis or kidney transplantation
index: One prespecified eligible clinic assessment per patient; all predictors measured at or before index_date
endpoint: First initiation of maintenance kidney replacement therapy (chronic dialysis or kidney transplant), clinically adjudicated; exclude temporary acute dialysis
event_date: Adjudicated first maintenance-dialysis start or transplant date; source reference mandatory for observed events
censoring: Last verified date under kidney-failure and mortality ascertainment; blank event date with event=false is not automatically a five-year non-event
competing_event: Death before kidney failure. Blank death date requires complete mortality ascertainment through followup_end_date

estimands.net: Cause-specific kidney-failure net risk under hypothetical removal of competing mortality; not real-world incidence
estimands.cif: Real-world kidney-failure cumulative incidence using paired cause-specific hazards for kidney failure and death
